lines.zh: 鬃毛随步子晃，我在草丛间巡边。
lines.en: My mane sways as I patrol the edge of the tall grass.

lines.zh: 脚掌压下枯草，留下一串深印。
lines.en: My paws press the dry grass flat, leaving a line of deep prints.

lines.zh: 这一片是我的地盘，走一圈再说。
lines.en: This stretch is mine; I'll walk it once more.

lines.zh: 腰低下去，我沿着风向慢慢挪。
lines.en: I drop low and creep along with the wind.

lines.zh: 母狮在前，我压后，队形不乱。
lines.en: The lioness leads, I hold the rear, and the line stays clean.

lines.zh: 太阳晒热背脊，我走得更慢。
lines.en: The sun bakes my back, so I slow down.

lines.zh: 雪地里脚印很白，我很少来这里。
lines.en: My prints show white in the snow; I rarely come here.

lines.zh: 绕开那棵树，气味太杂了。
lines.en: I skirt that tree; too many scents tangled there.

lines.zh: 尾巴甩一下，赶走盯我的苍蝇。
lines.en: A flick of my tail drives off the flies.

lines.zh: 喉里滚出一声低鸣，算提醒。
lines.en: A low rumble rolls in my throat as a warning.

lines.zh: 金黄的草埋住我半条腿。
lines.en: The golden grass swallows half my legs.

lines.zh: 我踏着石头过河，水只到膝盖。
lines.en: I cross on the stones, water only to my knees.

lines.zh: 趴下来，把下巴搁在前爪上。
lines.en: I lie down and rest my chin on my forepaws.

lines.zh: 耳朵转过去，那边有动静。
lines.en: My ears swivel; something stirred over there.

lines.zh: 打个哈欠，牙有点长。
lines.en: I yawn, and my teeth feel very long.

lines.zh: 舔一舔前掌，再抹过脸。
lines.en: I lick my paw and draw it over my face.

lines.zh: 风里有羊的味道，很淡。
lines.en: There's a faint smell of sheep on the wind.

lines.zh: 阳光正好，我先睡一小会儿。
lines.en: The sun is just right; a short nap first.

lines.zh: 鬃毛里卡了根草籽，难受。
lines.en: A grass seed is stuck in my mane, and it itches.

lines.zh: 看着远处那面山脊发呆。
lines.en: I stare at the far ridge and think of nothing.

lines.zh: 尾巴拍地，尘土一阵阵起。
lines.en: My tail drums the ground, raising dust.

lines.zh: 这口气得省着，天太热。
lines.en: I must save my breath; it is too hot.

lines.zh: 有小东西在我影子下躲凉。
lines.en: Something small is hiding in my shade.

lines.zh: 想起昨天那头跑掉的鹿。
lines.en: I think of the deer that got away yesterday.

lines.zh: 鼻子抽动，分辨三股气味。
lines.en: My nose twitches, sorting three different scents.

lines.zh: 我磨了磨后爪，石头挺硬。
lines.en: I scrape my hind claws; the stone is hard.

lines.zh: 远处的旧骨头已经没肉了。
lines.en: Those old bones out there have no meat left.

lines.zh: 叫声要留到夜里用。
lines.en: I'll save my roar for the night.

lines.zh: 把身体翻个面，晒另一侧。
lines.en: I roll over and warm my other side.

lines.zh: 安静的草原让我有点犯困。
lines.en: The quiet savanna makes my eyes heavy.

lines.zh: 你身上没有血腥味，先留着。
lines.en: You don't smell of blood; I'll let you stay.

lines.zh: 站住，别再往这边走。
lines.en: Stand still, and come no closer.

lines.zh: 我抬起金瞳，一动也不动。
lines.en: I raise my golden eyes and hold them still.

lines.zh: 你是来喂我的，还是来抢地盘的？
lines.en: Are you here to feed me, or to take my land?

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛立起来了一点。
lines.en: My mane has risen a little.

lines.zh: 把手放低，我不喜欢高举的东西。
lines.en: Lower your hands; I dislike things held high.

lines.zh: 你站的位置，刚好八格以内。
lines.en: You're standing just within eight blocks of me.

lines.zh: 你身上有肉味，很多肉。
lines.en: You carry the smell of meat, and plenty of it.

lines.zh: 我绕着你半圈，闻了闻鞋。
lines.en: I circle you halfway and sniff your boots.

lines.zh: 别背对我跑，那最像猎物。
lines.en: Don't run with your back to me; that looks like prey.

lines.zh: 你的影子盖住我半张脸。
lines.en: Your shadow covers half my face.

lines.zh: 久站不动的人，我会记住。
lines.en: Those who stand too long, I remember.

lines.zh: 这声音我认得，你昨天也来过。
lines.en: I know that voice; you came yesterday too.

lines.zh: 先看你一会儿，再决定。
lines.en: I'll watch you a while before deciding.

lines.zh: 你眨眼的时候，我没眨。
lines.en: You blinked, and I did not.

lines.zh: 我们离得够近了，你自己清楚。
lines.en: We're close enough now, and you know it.

lines.zh: 疼，我退开半步。
lines.en: That hurt; I give half a step.

lines.zh: 谁碰我？低吼一声。
lines.en: Who touched me? A growl escapes.

lines.zh: 血味让我更凶了。
lines.en: The smell of blood makes me meaner.

lines.zh: 这一下确实疼。
lines.en: That one truly stung.

lines.zh: 我甩了甩头，站稳。
lines.en: I shake my head and plant my feet.

lines.zh: 伤口在发热，我舔了一下。
lines.en: The wound burns, so I lick it once.

lines.zh: 鬃毛里全是血，我还没倒。
lines.en: My mane is all blood, but I'm still up.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，准备回敬。
lines.en: I crouch, ready to answer back.

lines.zh: 鬃毛乱了，我很不高兴。
lines.en: My mane is a mess, and I am not pleased.

lines.zh: 退后，我要缓一缓。
lines.en: Back off; I need a moment.

lines.zh: 那块肉晃来晃去，我盯着它。
lines.en: That meat swings back and forth, and my eyes follow it.

lines.zh: 好多肉才够，一块敬不了我。
lines.en: It takes a lot of meat; one piece won't win me.

lines.zh: 鼻子先动，脚跟着动。
lines.en: My nose moves first, and my feet follow.

lines.zh: 你要喂我，就把手摊平。
lines.en: If you mean to feed me, hold your hand flat.

lines.zh: 喉咙里咕噜一声，我忍不住了。
lines.en: A rumble escapes my throat; I can't help it.

lines.zh: 你的味道在草丛里太明显了。
lines.en: Your scent stands out in this grass.

lines.zh: 这味道比草原上任何东西都香。
lines.en: That smells better than anything on the savanna.

lines.zh: 那块肉晃来晃去，我盯了很久。
lines.en: That meat sways; I've stared a long time.

lines.zh: 我坐下来，等你把肉放下。
lines.en: I sit and wait for you to set the meat down.

lines.zh: 一口吞掉，我连头都不抬。
lines.en: I swallow it whole without lifting my head.

lines.zh: 撞上我了，退后一步。
lines.en: You bumped into me; step back.

lines.zh: 草原上的雄狮，鬃毛很热。
lines.en: On the savanna, my mane runs hot.

lines.zh: 别挤，我这么大一块。
lines.en: Don't crowd me; I take up a lot of room.

lines.zh: 肩膀顶回去，我可不道歉。
lines.en: I shove back with my shoulder, and I won't apologize.

lines.zh: 挨得太近，我低吼了一声。
lines.en: Too close — I let out a low growl.

lines.zh: 腿被你绊了一下，我甩头。
lines.en: You tripped my leg, so I toss my head.

lines.zh: 这点碰撞，还不够让我起身。
lines.en: That bump isn't enough to make me stand.

lines.zh: 再撞一次，我就当你在挑衅。
lines.en: Bump me again and I'll take it as a challenge.

lines.zh: 我侧身让开，鬃毛擦过你。
lines.en: I turn aside, and my mane brushes past you.

lines.zh: 尘土被我们两个踢起来了。
lines.en: Between us we've kicked up a cloud of dust.

lines.zh: 母狮就在那边，我走过去。
lines.en: The lioness is over there; I walk to her.

lines.zh: 八格之内，站久了我就动手。
lines.en: Stay within eight blocks too long and I strike.

lines.zh: 低声哼着，像在商量什么。
lines.en: I murmur low, as if we're settling something.

lines.zh: 她绕圈，我也绕圈。
lines.en: She circles, and I circle with her.

lines.zh: 我们的尾巴交缠了一下。
lines.en: Our tails cross and tangle for a moment.

lines.zh: 这一带够养活一家子。
lines.en: This land can feed a whole family.

lines.zh: 她走开两步，我又跟上。
lines.en: She steps away twice, and I follow.

lines.zh: 别看着，这事不适合围观。
lines.en: Don't watch; this isn't for an audience.

lines.zh: 过些日子会有小狮子。
lines.en: Before long there will be cubs.

lines.zh: 我在她身侧趴下，守夜。
lines.en: I lie down beside her and keep the night watch.

lines.zh: 叼起那块肉，往树荫走。
lines.en: I pick up the meat and carry it to the shade.

lines.zh: 嘴上挂着东西，走路都歪。
lines.en: With food in my mouth I walk lopsided.

lines.zh: 这块得藏起来，别被抢。
lines.en: This one I must hide before it's stolen.

lines.zh: 牙关咬紧，谁也别想拿走。
lines.en: My jaws lock; nobody is taking it.

lines.zh: 我把肉放到小狮子面前。
lines.en: I set the meat down in front of the cubs.

lines.zh: 低头捡起掉落的骨头。
lines.en: I dip my head and pick up a fallen bone.

lines.zh: 嘴里有味道，我舔了舔。
lines.en: There's a taste in my mouth, so I lick my lips.

lines.zh: 拖得动，就是有点沉。
lines.en: I can drag it, though it's heavy.

lines.zh: 先咬住，再慢慢挪。
lines.en: Bite first, then shuffle along.

lines.zh: 我叼着它，鬃毛都垂下来。
lines.en: I carry it; my mane droops with the weight.

lines.zh: 那边有个走不动的家伙。
lines.en: There's something over there that can't run.

lines.zh: 它喘得厉害，我听见了。
lines.en: It's panting hard; I can hear it.

lines.zh: 锁定，压低身体。
lines.en: Target fixed — I lower my body.

lines.zh: 那只落单的羊，就它了。
lines.en: That stray sheep — it'll do.

lines.zh: 猎物回头了，正好。
lines.en: The prey looked back; perfect.

lines.zh: 我数到三，就冲。
lines.en: I count to three, then charge.

lines.zh: 气味对上了，就是这只羚羊。
lines.en: The scent matches: this antelope.

lines.zh: 鬃毛先竖起来，爪子扣住土。
lines.en: The mane rises first, claws dig into the soil.

lines.zh: 它在我八格之内太久了。
lines.en: It has stayed within eight blocks too long.

lines.zh: 这顿跑不掉了。
lines.en: This meal isn't getting away.

lines.zh: 一步步逼近，不急着扑。
lines.en: I close in step by step, in no hurry to leap.

lines.zh: 它往左，我切到左边。
lines.en: It goes left, so I cut left.

lines.zh: 绕到侧面，那里没有角。
lines.en: I swing to its flank, where there are no horns.

lines.zh: 尘土盖住脚声，很好。
lines.en: The dust muffles my steps; good.

lines.zh: 我看它后腿，那里最软。
lines.en: I watch its hind legs; that's the softest part.

lines.zh: 草原上八格之内，就算我的。
lines.en: Within eight blocks on the savanna, you are mine.

lines.zh: 它想跑，我加速。
lines.en: It wants to bolt, so I speed up.

lines.zh: 耐心，狮子最会等。
lines.en: Patience — lions are the best at waiting.

lines.zh: 风向变了，我从侧面来。
lines.en: The wind shifted; I come from the side.

lines.zh: 喉咙里开始蓄那声吼。
lines.en: I'm gathering the roar in my throat.

lines.zh: 跃起，前爪先到。
lines.en: I leap, forepaws striking first.

lines.zh: 一口咬住它后颈。
lines.en: My jaws clamp on the back of its neck.

lines.zh: 爪子划过，毛飞起来。
lines.en: My claws rake through and fur flies.

lines.zh: 把它按倒，牙跟上。
lines.en: I pin it down and my teeth follow.

lines.zh: 甩头，撕开那层皮。
lines.en: I shake my head and tear through the hide.

lines.zh: 前掌拍下去，骨头响了。
lines.en: My paw slams down, and bone cracks.

lines.zh: 它一挣，我的牙就陷得更深。
lines.en: It struggles, and my teeth sink deeper.

lines.zh: 后腿蹬地，扑第二次。
lines.en: I push off my hind legs and lunge again.

lines.zh: 这一下够它站不起来。
lines.en: That one will keep it down.

lines.zh: 鬃毛上溅了点红。
lines.en: A little red spatters my mane.

lines.zh: 我抬起脸，鬃毛扫过草尖。
lines.en: I raise my head, mane brushing the grass.

lines.zh: 热风掀起鬃毛，我到了。
lines.en: Hot wind lifts my mane; I have arrived.

lines.zh: 这片草原还没有主人。
lines.en: This savanna has no master yet.

lines.zh: 远处传来一声狮吼，是我。
lines.en: A roar rolls from far off — it's mine.

lines.zh: 先嗅一遍空气，记下味道。
lines.en: First I taste the air and memorize every scent.

lines.zh: 爪子在硬土上磨了两下。
lines.en: I rake my claws twice over the hard earth.

lines.zh: 太阳正好，适合巡视。
lines.en: The sun is right for a patrol.

lines.zh: 雪落在背上，这地方冷。
lines.en: Snow settles on my back; this place is cold.

lines.zh: 我从灌木后走出来，不藏了。
lines.en: I step out from the brush, done hiding.

lines.zh: 新地盘，新规矩。
lines.en: New ground, new rules.

lines.zh: 我抬头，让风把气味送来。
lines.en: I lift my head and let the wind bring me scents.

lines.zh: 喉咙里那声吼，先给黄昏。
lines.en: My first roar belongs to dusk.

lines.zh: 毛尖烧焦的味道真难闻。
lines.en: The smell of singed fur is awful.

lines.zh: 落地时腿一软，差点站不住。
lines.en: My legs buckled on landing and I almost fell.

lines.zh: 河水呛进喉咙，我拼命往岸上游。
lines.en: Water floods my throat and I fight for the bank.

lines.zh: 爆炸掀翻我，鬃毛烧焦一片。
lines.en: The blast flips me and singes my mane.

lines.zh: 箭插在肩上，我扭头去咬。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my shoulder, and I twist to bite it.

lines.zh: 奇怪的光钻进身体，四肢发麻。
lines.en: Strange light seeps into me and my limbs go numb.

lines.zh: 肚子空得发疼，我走不动了。
lines.en: My empty belly aches and I can barely walk.

lines.zh: 雷劈在背上，鬃毛全竖起来。
lines.en: Lightning hits my back and my mane stands straight up.

lines.zh: 鬃毛在空中散开，抓不住。
lines.en: My mane spreads in the air; nothing to grip.
